description: Header file defining structures, constants, and inline functions for managing pack objects in a version control system, including object entries, packing data, and delta management.

methods.name: prepare_packing_data
methods.description: Prepares packing data structures for a repository.

methods.name: clear_packing_data
methods.description: Clears and deallocates packing data structures.

methods.name: packlist_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new object entry in the packlist for a given object ID.

methods.name: packlist_find
methods.description: Finds an object entry in the packlist by object ID.

methods.name: oe_map_new_pack
methods.description: Maps a new pack into the object packing data.

methods.name: oe_set_delta_ext
methods.description: Sets external delta information for an object entry.
